## Changes

## Validation

## Checklist

- [ ] I added or updated tests for non-trivial behavior changes.
- [ ] I updated documentation for command, configuration, persistence, or security changes.
- [ ] I did not include credentials, private data, generated runtime data, or unrelated changes.
- [ ] I considered compatibility with macOS, Windows, and Linux.
- [ ] I documented any persisted-data migration or upgrade impact.
